parallax.description: Background image translates at 0.7x scroll speed via JS transform

slowZoom.description: Images scale from 1.0 to 1.08 on scroll enter

letterboxReveal.description: Clip-path inset(20% 0 20% 0) to inset(0 0 0 0) on image enter

fadeUp.description: Text blocks fade up from y:40 on scroll enter

principles: Photography requires slower, more deliberate motion than tech products
Images move at different speeds than text (parallax)
Reveals expand from letterbox crop — cinematic framing
No sudden or bouncy animation — stillness is part of the aesthetic
once:true on all ScrollTrigger — do not repeat on scroll back
_source: Photography-forward editorial motion — cinema-inspired, deliberate pacing
